Previous Cesarean section for breech presentation
Women who chose ERCS vs. TOLAC
Trial of labor after Cesarean section (TOLAC)
GA at delivery greater than 40 weeks
cohort: Women with live singleton gestations delivering at term in St. John's, NL between January 1, 2001 and December 31, 2014, with a previous single lower segment Cesarean section (LSCS)
finding: The overall TOLAC and VBAC rates in St. John's are low compared to national rates, but the successful TOLAC rate is within the expected range.
mod_finding: Women who chose ERCS were less likely to have had a previous vaginal delivery compared to those who chose TOLAC.
